limits: One model and one trajectory per arm; no statistical or universal CLI claim.
Same source bytes and business prompts. Native final answer versus explicit schema-bound native StructuredOutput intent, followed by real Worker publication.
Standalone manual Host/Kernel prototype, not production scheduler/adapter acceptance.
No retries or discarded incorrect outputs; stop dependent work on failure and retain all reported usage.
Path-specific filesystem barrier, not a general network or whole-host security sandbox.
toolSelection: Same OpenCode build working tools in both arms; task/question/skill/web tools disabled equally. Terminal adds only native StructuredOutput in explicit Host FinalReply mode.
revisionReason: New explicit native FinalReply interface: model schema contains body only; Host binds final=true from enabled terminal mode and current unique native capture. Full synthetic Host publication receipts are written via noReply and remain in measured native history.
workspacePolicy: Prior control and peer denials plus repository docs/evo/evidence denial (published answer oracle).

retryPolicy.upstreamTransportRetries: CLI-owned; not independently observed or advertised as disabled

budget.enforcement: Check before starting each native turn; retain all costs of completed/failed turns. These are between-turn stop thresholds, not a provider billing hard cap.

receiptPolicy: True Worker published receipt written as synthetic Host diagnostic via noReply in same native session, then Activation completion. Failure never resends business action; finally records proven native turn settlement without ACK/completion.
comparisonRules: Same immutable budget.csv and exact business prompts as P136/P138/P139.
One continuous independent native session per arm; alternating odd native-first/even terminal-first.
Native and terminal disable external memories/instructions/skills and have isolated config/data/workspaces.
No same-branch legacy response substitution, stdout inference, string true coercion, discarded failure or paid rerun.
Output JSON parse rule unchanged from P139 (outer markdown code fence tolerated, trailing commentary rejected).
No full efficiency verdict when incomplete; failed-turn usage stays in full batch totals and completed-prefix comparison labeled separately.
approvalState: prepared; internal lead review required before --paid launch; no paid launch performed
diagnosticCostAccounting: Every persisted native generation is counted, including invalid tool repair, retries visible in session, failed final intent and future input containing full Host diagnostic receipts. No provider request is made solely for noReply receipt persistence.
